title: CR69003: Cryo. Systems Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Theory and practical explanation of nitrogen liquefier: MNP 12; Description and
Demonstration of parts/accessories of nitrogen liquefier: MNP 12; Liquid
nitrogen plant operation, measurement of production rate, purity and power
consumption: MNP 12; Theory and practical explanation of nitrogen liquefier:
PLN-106; Description and Demonstration of parts/accessories of nitrogen
liquefier: PLN-106; Theory and demonstration of Water Chilling Plant; Theory
and demonstration of Cooling Tower; Vacuum Insulation of Dewars, theory,
demonstration and re-evacuation of Dewars; Theory and demonstration of
operation of Cryogenic valves and transfer devices; Theory, demonstration and
operation of Air/Gas compressor and accessories; Theory of CryoFreezing and
demonstration of Cryo-freezer
